#Cybersecurity #SecurityEngineering #CyberShieldSolutions  
Priya Sharma | Security Engineer at CyberShield Solutions | 5 years shaping safer digital worlds  

I’m a Security Engineer at CyberShield Solutions, where I spend my days building defenses against evolving threats. My work blends technical rigor with a focus on practical impact—whether it’s designing secure APIs that align with OWASP guidelines or ensuring systems meet SOC2 and GDPR standards.  

A big part of my role involves balancing protection with usability. For example, I recently led a project to streamline IAM processes for a client, cutting access friction by 40% without compromising security. I also dive deep into incident response, turning post-breach analysis into proactive safeguards.  

Outside of code, I’m passionate about making cybersecurity accessible. I’ve contributed to open-source tools that help teams audit encryption practices, and I regularly collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed security into product development from the start.  

Looking ahead, I’m excited about the potential of AI in threat detection and how zero-trust frameworks will reshape how we protect data. Let’s build a safer internet—one line of code at a time.  

*Skills: Application Security, Compliance, Encryption, IAM, Incident Response, Network Security, Penetration Testing, SIEM, Security Auditing, Threat Modeling, Vulnerability Management*
